data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (two xe.com conversions to USD, a timeanddate city lookup, then a Mail compose with the right recipient, subject and body), but it ends with a vague "Send or discard" when the true workflow must discard and never send. It also adds a recipient parameter that is actually fixed, and it leaves out the To=USD, Convert and tab-switching details, so an automation built from it would be somewhat ambiguous and could send the email by mistake.
